narration.en: Our data comes from interactive portals like ASAP and GSCM, where we download ready-made reports.
narration.spoken: Our data comes from interactive portals like A S A P and G S C M, where we download ready-made reports.

narration.en: But downloads alone aren't ready for analysis or scheduled reporting. We still need to extract the data, standardize its format, and load it into a destination.
narration.spoken: But downloads alone aren't ready for analysis or scheduled reporting. We still need to extract the data, standardize its format, and load it into a destination.

narration.en: Meet Metronome. Build data pipelines in minutes, without code. Schedule them, trigger a run when you need it, and track every run in one place.
narration.spoken: Meet Metronome. Build data pipelines in minutes, without code. Schedule them, trigger a run when you need it, and track every run in one place.

narration.en: Instead of writing a script, build a Flow. Pick a website, a report, a destination and a schedule.
narration.spoken: Instead of writing a script, build a Flow. Pick a website, a report, a destination and a schedule.

narration.en: While the script is still being written, your Flow is ready, loading fresh data into PostgreSQL every morning.

narration.en: But fresh data is only half the job. Leaders still ask questions that cut across every system.
narration.spoken: But fresh data is only half the job. Leaders still ask questions that cut across every system.

narration.en: Meet Wizard, your executive analyst. Ask in plain language, and Gemini checks every approved source, under your own sign-in.
narration.spoken: Meet Wizard, your executive analyst. Ask in plain language, and Gemini checks every approved source, under your own sign-in.

narration.en: Ask which market got the most from its marketing spend last quarter.
narration.spoken: Ask which market got the most from its marketing spend last quarter.

narration.en: Wizard decides what to read: spend from NERP, sell-out from the tables Metronome keeps fresh, and share from ASAP.

narration.en: Then it writes the answer: Egypt ranks first on investment efficiency, ahead of Saudi Arabia and the UAE.

narration.en: Every number links to its source. Check my data recomputes it. Open the evidence to see the exact query.
